12-1.title: Design a RAG system: tests failure-mode awareness
12-1.tldr: 'Design a RAG system' tests whether you know how it fails, not whether you can draw boxes.
points: Dense fallback only on empty, not on wrong.
score_threshold defaults none → weak chunks pass.
Metadata filters dropped at the retriever.

12-2.title: Compare two approaches: tests tradeoff reasoning
12-2.tldr: 'Compare two approaches' tests tradeoff reasoning tied to numbers, not a correct pick.
points: Reranking absent from the KB path.

12-3.title: 'The agent is stuck': tests shipped experience
12-3.tldr: 'The agent is stuck' tests whether you've shipped one, not studied one.

12-4.title: How do you know it's working: eval depth
12-4.tldr: 'How do you know it's working' tests evaluation depth, not confidence.

12-5.title: Scaling questions: thinking past the demo
12-5.tldr: Scaling questions test whether you've thought past the demo.

12-6.title: Security-adjacent questions in disguise
12-6.tldr: Security-adjacent questions are disguised as normal engineering questions.
points: Tool results not framed as untrusted.
Real control is the shell/permission layer.

12-7.title: Stakeholder questions: judgment under pressure
12-7.tldr: Stakeholder questions test judgment under pressure, not technical depth.
